provenance.method: Generated for structcorpus from the published yamlprims specification revision 1.3, sections 3, 4.4, and 5.1; each value is written out in the generator.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Tag-heavy inputs: flow sequences of 10 to 10,000 tiny tagged scalars, tags on collections, keys, and values, core tags beside non-core ones (core tags add no wrapper; the non-specific tag gives a String), keys that differ only by tag, and one 1000-byte tag. Bound to the revision 1.3 profile; expectations are identical to the revision 1.1 recipe because no input in this set is affected by 1.2/E-1 to E-3 or 1.3/E-1 to E-4.
